label: Natural light of human reason: P.AnswersToSharedReason m: the correctness of m answers to…
term: natural light of human reason (shared sense)
definition: `P.AnswersToSharedReason m`: the correctness of m answers to standards of reason shared with those outside the practice, available without the practice's revelation or authority. This is the sense in which STMT-NATURAL-REASON-IS-SHARED-REASON reads Dei Filius's 'naturali humanae rationis lumine', set against revelation 'alia, eaque supernaturali via'.
note: Stipulated reading of the council's phrase; the text supports it by the contrast with the supernatural way but does not define the phrase. DISAMB-NATURAL-REASON records the rival practice-internal sense.

formal_gap.meaning: Practice.AnswersToSharedReason m says that the correctness of the move m answers to standards of reason shared with those outside the practice, available without the practice's revelation or authority. It is the shared sense in which STMT-NATURAL-REASON-IS-SHARED-REASON reads Dei Filius's 'naturali humanae rationis lumine'. It is a field of a religious practice viewed as a language game (TruthCore.Alternatives.Fideism, #1010), supplied by each model.
examples: An argument from created things to a first cause whose validity a nonbeliever can assess, read as a move answering to shared reason.
exclusions: The practice-internal re-reading of natural reason (DEF-NATURAL-REASON-PRACTICE-INTERNAL), the rival sense in DISAMB-NATURAL-REASON.
Correctness by the practice's own grammar (Correct) or own standards (OwnStandard).
